instrument: KCC Docket 25-EKME-315-TAR, Evergy Large Load Power Service tariff (approved Nov 6, 2025)
summary: Applies to new load or growth above 75 MW peak: minimum 12-year term plus optional 5-year ramp, auto-extends 5 years, minimum bill of 80% of contract demand, collateral covering two years of minimum bills, 36-month exit notice.

source.citation: KCC news release; KCC Senate Utilities update Jan 15, 2026; Kansas Reflector

notes: CONFLICT: De Soto city FAQ describes the threshold as >100 MW expected and at least 75 MW in any month; KCC materials say >75 MW peak. Compare FERC ComEd $1 letter-of-credit dispute.
